title: Entanglement Builds Space-Time. Now "Magic" Gives It Gravity
summary: This article explores how quantum entanglement may be the fundamental building block of space-time geometry, and how 'quantum magic' (computational complexity) relates to gravitational physics. It discusses cutting-edge theoretical physics research connecting quantum information theory with the nature of gravity.
problem_solved: How quantum entanglement and computational complexity relate to the fundamental structure of space-time and the origin of gravity.
why_valuable: It bridges the gap between quantum information science and gravitational physics, potentially leading toward a unified theory of quantum gravity.
